top_signals.title: Investors Return to JGBs as Rate Outlook Shifts, SMBC Nikko Says
top_signals.summary: Investors both at home and abroad are adding to positions in Japanese government debt as the surge in bond yields shows signs of peaking and concerns over artificial intelligence grow, according to SMBC Nikko Securities Inc.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Takaichi heads to Asia summits with focus on warming chilly ties with China
top_signals.summary: The Japanese leader will visit the Philippines and China, where a key focus will be improving ties with Beijing and like-minded partners.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Nvidia Shares Poised to Steady as Investors Eye Comeback Report
top_signals.summary: Nvidia Corp.’s stock may see some relief after the Financial Times reported Jensen Huang is discussing a possible comeback to the chipmaker.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
